lines: {target}? Shorelines change under your feet. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for Beach, tell them: Watch the <wavy>tide</wavy>, the turtles, and the drowned at dusk. I will be at the map table.
Sand looks peaceful until it shifts. I will mark that beside the road home.
Beach is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember Beach as the place where land starts losing to water. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Calm water can still go bottomless. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for Deep Lukewarm Ocean, tell them: Do not mistake warm waves for safe waves. I will be at the map table.
The color is kind; the depth is not. I will mark that beside the road home.
Deep Lukewarm Ocean is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember Deep Lukewarm Ocean as warm water with a long fall under it. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Deep water does not care who can swim. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for Deep Ocean, tell them: Take a boat and count your air honestly. I will be at the map table.

Deep Ocean is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember Deep Ocean as open water with no nearby door. I will mark the warning beside the road.
